specClauses.wording: Implement internal process execution with argument arrays, cancellation, environment scoping and diagnostic redaction; keep helper APIs internal.
Paths containing spaces and Unicode reach javac and child applications unchanged on each advertised OS.
Cancellation terminates owned children and leaves reusable previous outputs intact.

rootRulings.decision: Own all Process instances launched by this component, including in-flight launches; cancellation terminates and joins each plus drainers. Descendant enumeration is not a containment proof; forced parent death and escaped descendants remain unqualified.
rootRulings.reason: Exact internal task/F04 and JDK/native source distinguish direct lifecycle from stronger OS containment
rootRulings.costIfWrong: Native adapter and lifecycle/oracle rework; no premature full credit

rootRulings.reason: Diagnostic redaction requirement does not promise OS secrecy

rootRulings.reason: Task explicitly internal APIs; no public CLI required

trustRule: Capture checks the two exact sibling manifest digests against this contract before any launch. Proof readers must anchor the reviewed contract digest outside producer-selected proof data; rehashing a reduced fixture/expected inventory does not change trusted requirements. Final source/class digest freeze is a separately reviewed OP07 extension, not an observation selected as its own expectation.

architecture.current: Same private evaluator remains. Provider-only seed and own-root launcher are accepted predecessors, not generic process capability.
architecture.proposed: Single owned internal Java process component in existing nonexporting SDK module; nested internal request/result/state types; no public Process facade, execute/debug CLI or duplicate evaluator.
architecture.ownership: Direct Process objects created by owner. Reserve launch slot before start; publish direct handle before use; cancellation closes admission and waits in-flight slots. Child may run before ProcessBuilder.start returns: this is not suspended creation or OS containment.
architecture.cancellation: Close stdin, concurrently drain bounded outputs, destroy then bounded grace/force, observe actual exit and join drainers. Preserve interrupt after cleanup; timeout/cleanup failure stays non-success. Never claim kill from future cancellation.
architecture.environment: Immutable per-operation copy, ProcessBuilder-local env, explicit cwd, platform case handling, no caller environment/cwd/Console encoding mutation. Reject malformed values and Java option injection.
architecture.argv: Arrays with exact selected executable identity, no shell concatenation. Actual Windows/Linux java/javac/app Unicode must be captured; inherited launcher proof is not proof of new process route.
architecture.redaction: SDK diagnostics use error categories/operation labels rather than raw request/Throwable messages. Test synthetic tagged secrets even if production discourages secret argv. Bound child data separately; do not automatically dump stdout/stderr into errors. Known-secret rendering must handle split chunks. Unknown transformations are not universally redactable.
architecture.telemetry: TRACE/JFR/OS argument observation is a separate explicit boundary. Base64 is not secrecy. Stronger secrecy requires a reviewed transport/telemetry contract; cannot be solved merely by excluding secret tests.
architecture.descendants: Snapshot observation may diagnose, not define or prove complete ownership. Dynamic descendants, escaped daemons, forced parent death and VM crash guarantees require separate native qualification if demanded by accepted predicate.

limits.timeouts: Query20s/owned operation120s existing maximum; proposed grace1s then force/join using remaining <=5s cleanup reserve. Bounds include cleanup; failure if not observed terminal.
limits.linux: Networknone/read-onlyroot/capdropALL/noNewPrivileges/CPU2/memory512MiB+swap512MiB/pids64/core0/inner25s/aggregate180s/reserve40s. Split finite groups, never raise caps silently.
limits.profiles: JDK21x64Windows/Linux; Windows printableASCII JDKhome, semantic256tokens/32768UTF16 and complete encoded native30000UTF16 guard. Linux C.UTF-8 and measured case-enabled9p/NTFS, not ext4. Windows isolated offline/Java25/macOS/ARM64/public distribution/global selector remain OPEN.

rules: Reserve before OS start; close admission on cancellation/close; wait all in-flight slots.
Publish/retain Process immediately after start before caller access; recheck cancellation even when start returned late.
Close stdin; drain both pipes concurrently within fixed byte bounds; overflow is non-success and triggers cleanup.
Destroy, wait up to1s then force if alive; observe exit and join all workers within remaining deadline and <=5s reserve.
Idempotent cancel/close; cleanup errors remain explicit; restore interrupted status after cleanup.
No success on outer-guard intervention; all owned handles and workers must have independently observed terminal state.

cli.contract: Absolute path to this versioned contract; sibling source-map.json and fixtures.json digest-bound before launch.
cli.output: Fresh absolute D-owned host directory; reject existing/nonempty root, reparse alias or path outside assigned task scratch.

exitCodes.0: Complete capture with all mandatory rows and observations; does not mean product parity passed.
exitCodes.1: Validation/capture/cleanup failure with retained failure receipt; never publish complete capture.
exitCodes.2: CLI usage failure before any launch.

fixture.offline: Clear package sources; all restore/build inputs local and explicitly recorded. Separate offline build before --no-build run. No implicit build/restore/network during capture.
fixture.resolution: Resolve dotnet/project/mode/request tokens to pinned executable, staged absolute project, fixed cohort mode and prelaunch request path; retain the literal final --. Append request.argv according to payloadRule. No unexpanded placeholder token is passed.
fixture.apiHarness: For R06/R07/R08 the run command only hosts the fixture. Record child ProcessStartInfo/ArgumentList invocation separately; do not attribute API wait or kill behavior to SDK Command/ProcessReaper.

payloadRule.assembly: Resolve the fixed command prefix tokens first, then append every request.argv token unchanged as a distinct argument after the final --. In R03 request.argv is exactly fixtures.corpus.argv. All SDK-command cohorts use this vector rule; other cases may have an empty payload array.
payloadRule.controlGrammar: After dotnet consumes its first --, fixture Main receives exactly --mode, mode, --request, absoluteRequestPath, --, then payload. Validate the first five tokens positionally; the fifth token is the fixture delimiter. Every token after it is payload, even empty strings, --mode, --request or --. Never scan payload for controls.
payloadRule.observation: Fixture derives received payload from its actual Main(string[] args) suffix after index4, and emits independently computed tokens, Unicode scalar arrays and UTF16 lengths. It reads request.json only for requested comparison/configuration, never as the received observation.
payloadRule.transport: Use the selected native SDK process argument array, no shell joining. Record the entire resolved actual SDK argv vector separately from the requested payload and the child-observed payload. An API-harness child does not replace this sdk-command observation.

jdk.transport: UNRESOLVED pending OP02C: record exact native argv and codepoints for actual java/javac, child cwd and result. No inherited launcher equivalence assertion.

requestFields.argv: ordered string array, exact UTF16 and Unicode scalar arrays retained
requestFields.environment: explicit inherited baseline descriptor plus set map/remove array; no ambient unknown baseline
requestFields.secrets: synthetic sentinel labels and values from fixtures only
requestFields.limits: exact typed bounds and platform caps
requestFields.effectsRoots: explicit owned staging, prior SDK, source and sibling sentinel paths
requestFields.argvCodepoints: Mandatory scalar arrays computed from requested payload argv before launch; compared to independently observed result.argvCodepoints.
requestFields.argvUtf16Lengths: Mandatory UTF16 code-unit lengths computed from requested payload argv before launch.

resultFields.platform: actual native OS/arch/locale and tool version evidence
resultFields.invocation: resolved actual executable argv cwd environment and input digest
resultFields.exitCode: actual integer only when exit observed; otherwise null
resultFields.handles: launchSlot, pid, startIdentity, retained, cancel/destroy/force events, observedExit, exitCode, terminal
resultFields.workers: stdin/stdout/stderr started, closed, terminal, joined, errorCategory
resultFields.streams: stdout/stderr byte length sha256 path and truncation boolean
resultFields.diagnostics: SDK-owned categorical diagnostic bytes and redaction checks, separate from raw streams
resultFields.outerGuard: used boolean, actions, observed terminal; intervention forces failed capture
resultFields.container: identity, caps, exit, removal/absence observation; null on Windows
resultFields.argvCodepoints: Mandatory ordered arrays of integer Unicode scalars derived independently from received payload argv, excluding fixture controls; never copied from request argv. Empty token is an empty scalar array.
resultFields.argvUtf16Lengths: Mandatory per-received-payload-token UTF16 code-unit lengths, including zero for an empty token.
resultFields.parentEnvironmentBefore: Mandatory complete case-preserving parent environment map captured before launching child.
resultFields.parentEnvironmentAfter: Mandatory complete case-preserving parent environment map after termination/cleanup; equals parentEnvironmentBefore. Child environment observations are separate.

effectsFields.before: Mandatory object with exactly source, priorSDK, siblings, staging keys; each is a complete relative-path map to type,bytes,sha256 descriptors, captured before operation.
effectsFields.after: Mandatory object with exactly source, priorSDK, siblings, staging keys; each has same inventory shape as before. source/priorSDK/siblings equal their respective before maps for preservation cases.
effectsFields.priorSdkSmoke: actual invocation streams exit after failure/cancel when required; not just hashes

protocol.aggregateRule: After completion, reference request.json becomes the row envelope defined by requestRetention, retaining exact prelaunch request bytes as base64. Product observation.json uses the same envelope. Four per-row files remain unchanged. Boundary observation.json contains ordered per-mode envelopes with raw stream offsets and actual invocations; all modes mandatory.
protocol.framing: UTF8 JSON, duplicate keys forbidden, finite numbers only; raw binary stdout/stderr unmodified. Echo emits actual received payload tokens, independently derived scalar arrays/UTF16 lengths, cwd and env. Request byte retention follows requestRetention exactly. READY events carry rowId and handle identity. File descriptors carry relative path, byte length and lowercase SHA256.
protocol.channels: Raw child protocol and TRACE/JFR/OS data retained in explicitly separate objects, never replayed as SDK-owned diagnostics. Only synthetic secret fixtures allowed.
protocol.guard: Outer owned-process guard must record direct processes/container and terminal cleanup. It protects the capture host only. Any guard cleanup needed for a product case makes that case/capture non-success; retain evidence and do not publish a complete proof.
protocol.normalization: Only explicit product names, fixture roots, timestamps and platform artifact representations may be compared with reviewed mappings. Never normalize exit status, codepoint loss, effects, missing warning, cancellation or telemetry exposure.

requestRetention.wireFile: Before launch request.json contains only the exact UTF8 request bytes R, with duplicate keys forbidden. The fixture reads R before completing; capture must retain R in memory until it writes the final envelope after fixture termination.
requestRetention.hashDomain: requestSha256 = lowercase SHA256(base64-decode(requestBytesBase64)), over the exact prelaunch bytes R, including whitespace and optional final newline. requestBytesLength = len(R). Result and effects requestSha256 must equal this digest. No parse/reserialize normalization is permitted.
requestRetention.roundTrip: Reader strictly base64-decodes R, validates its length/hash and UTF8 JSON, then uses that parsed object as the request. There is no separately authoritative nested request object.
requestRetention.finalEnvelopeDigest: The descriptor in the aggregate/proof hashes final envelope file bytes E independently, after result insertion. No digest of E is stored inside E. The graph is aggregate -> E -> R and result/effects -> SHA256(R), never E -> SHA256(E).

proofEnvelope.keying: referenceRows/productRows/boundaryGroups maps keyed by frozen IDs; sources by repo-relative path; artifact.classes by full JAR entry. readers uses exactly read_proof.py,evidence_schema.py,seed/proof_reader.py and seed/inherited/{read_proof.py,compare.py,corpus.py,native_lock.py,inherited_models.py}, corresponding to readerBundleMapping after removing leading reader/. JSON Pointer applies to the materialized projection described below.
proofEnvelope.controls: baseProof,currentReader,scopeSha256,60 exact negative IDs and execution receipts; final proof references nonfinal base to avoid cyclic hash. Old154 scope remains separate.
proofEnvelope.completeness: Exact fixed key sets from fixtures, immutable reviewed final class set from OP07, actual byte hashes. Missing keys, unexpected members, duplicate JSON keys, unresolved observed digests, failed receipts or wrong-row objects reject.

rowProjection.platform: Row platform is the request platform enum, independently required to match the frozen row ID/profile.
rowProjection.request: Strictly decode retained R from verified envelope and parse once; this is the sole request object in the projection.
rowProjection.result: Inline parsed envelope.result with exactly protocol.resultFields; no implicit renaming or synthesized observation fields.
rowProjection.effects: Resolve result.effects descriptor using bundled relative path, verify its bytes/SHA256, then parse and inline with exactly protocol.effectsFields. It is not a descriptor at mutation-pointer time.
rowProjection.binding: result/effects rowId and requestSha256 must match projected request and exact retained R. Request/result/effects are materialized only after verifying external object descriptors.
rowProjection.mutation: Pointers address this projection. For referenceRows/platform mutation, alter the backing retained request platform and rebuild R/envelope. Other mutations alter their identified backing object. Recompute affected R/envelope/object/aggregate hashes and descriptors without changing the frozen fixture/expected assertion. Mutations must resolve to an existing member in valid base, and must be rejected by their named semantic predicate, not merely by a stale hash.
